plan.notes: Designed for transfer to a 4-year college/university under a specific 2+2 articulation agreement/plan; students should contact an academic advisor for transfer agreement details. Catalog prints the program as 60-62 credit hours ('Total Hours 60-62'); the final Semester 4 directed elective is 1-3 credit hours. This plan records the standard 3-credit configuration (total 62); students on a 60-hour articulation take fewer elective hours. Catalog placement/eligibility notes ('Placement score or required remediation', 'Eligible for Comp I', 'See catalog or consult an academic advisor for math placement information') are eligibility requirements, not course prerequisites. Directed electives are determined by the articulation agreement — consult advisor.
